column1: # The old runtime's own spread per harness row and GPU leg: the widest ratio between two of
# its runs of the row in one leg (old over old), the largest of its 4 times over the smallest.
# results.HARNESS_FLOORS reads it; a row or leg missing here has a floor of 1. Measured with the
# harness of 4cc7963005 (a row's time the lowest mean of its windows of 10 timed runs), 4 runs of
# `harness --runtime old` per leg in the order A B B A, each its own process with a fresh driver
# shader cache and store, a sized row at the first run's size; measured again when the harness
# or the old runtime's build changes.
